purpose: Store approved and rejected website visuals by exact commercial slot so premium quality becomes reusable instead of one-off generation spend.
rules: Every generated asset must map to a website slot before credits are spent.
Master still first; motion only after the still scores at least 10/12.
One coherent recurring technician/world beats unrelated high-quality generations.
Real project proof remains real; AI atmosphere may never be labeled as completed client work.
Rejected assets remain archived with rejection reason so failed directions are not repeated.
A paying-client customization should start from an approved composition/system rather than from a blank prompt whenever possible.

Does it feel premium while still credible for the operator?
Are tools, hands, plumbing/material details and lighting believable?
Does it make the service/problem/result easier to understand or trust?
Is resolution/composition strong enough for responsive desktop + mobile use?
